title: Legacy Bridge
description: Converts legacy Minecraft maps (1.0-1.12.2) to modern 1.21.10 - migrates command blocks, resource packs, and outdated block data automatically.
body:
# Legacy Bridge MC                                                                                                                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  ### Full Legacy Map Conversion                                                                                                                                                                                          
                  
  Automatically converts legacy Minecraft maps (1.0-1.12.2) to 1.21.10. Handles command blocks, resource packs, block data values, and more — all in one mod.

  **Current Status: 🟡 70% of 1.12.2 maps should be fully compatible with 1.21.10**

  *Decent 1.0 to 1.11.x map coverage*

  ## Roadmap

  🟡 1.12.x to 1.21.10 (Current Focus)

  🟠 1.13.x to Latest Minecraft Release

  🔴 1.12.x to 1.13.x

  🔴 Every Other Version

  ## Instructions
